story: Keaīwa Heiau State Recreation Area is a forest located on Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi, featuring the ruins of a 16th-century stone temple. The recreation area includes camping facilities and a trail where native ohia lehua and koa trees may be viewed.
matters: The site contains abundant medicinal herbs that were used as an ancient herbal clinic by kahuna for healing medicine. Visitors still leave temple offerings here hoping to experience medicinal benefits.
name: Keaīwa Heiau State Recreation Area
